items.sentence: The magnificence of Venice, which was built on the sea more than a thousand years ago, *sets* it apart from any other city in the world.

items.sentence: In recent years, however, Venice *has become* a city at risk, sinking and flooding as a result of both natural conditions and human activities.

items.sentence: This, as one would expect, greatly *increases* the likelihood of flooding.

text_genre.raw_text:
The text follows a Cause-and-Effect pattern (addressing an environmental or lifestyle issue outside of tourism/flooding):
Introduction (Para 1): Introduces Venice's unique history and beauty, followed by the thesis statement (Venice is sinking and flooding due to natural conditions and human activities).
Body 1: Natural Factors (Para 2): Details natural causes—acqua alta (high tides/winds) and natural land subsidence (marshland foundation and shifting tectonic plates).
Body 2: Human Factors (Para 3): Details human causes—historical underground water pumping (accelerated sinking) and global climate change (rising sea levels due to fossil fuel emissions).
Body 3: Consequences & Countermeasures (Para 4): Illustrates the severe impact (increased flood frequency, record-high floods in 1966 and 2019) and mentions a technological response (the MOSE barrier system).
Conclusion (Para 5): Summarizes the situation as a global test, urging worldwide collective action against climate change to protect vulnerable areas for future generations.
